_doc: Per-model facts for the bake-off page (build_page.py). Measured on the M5 Max / 128 GB, 2026-09-22. Speed = wall time for one take incl. decode; memory = peak process RSS (/usr/bin/time -l) unless noted.

HeartMuLa.status: ran - 24 takes (first, spaced tag string; see briefs.json _heartmula_note)
HeartMuLa.backend: MLX (heartlib-mlx port), LM bf16, codec fp32
HeartMuLa.speed: 75 s of audio in 165-242 s (avg 192 s): ~5 frames/s at 12.5 Hz, 0.4x real time
HeartMuLa.memory: MLX peak 25.5 GB (incl. codec decode); ~12 GB RSS

Stable Audio Open.status: ran - 24 takes; capped at 47 s per generation
Stable Audio Open.speed: 47 s clip in 64-94 s (avg 76 s), 100 steps, CFG 7
Stable Audio Open.licence: Stability AI Community License: free below USD 1M annual revenue; register with Stability for commercial use; 'Powered by Stability AI' attribution

Stable Audio Open Small.status: ran - 24 takes; ~11 s window, loops/one-shots only (never shortlisted as a theme)
Stable Audio Open Small.speed: 11 s clip in 0.4 s warm (7 s on the first call), 8 steps

MiniMax Music 3.status: ran - 24 takes (the model card says CUDA-only; runs on MPS unchanged via diffusers 0.40)
MiniMax Music 3.speed: 75 s of audio in 151-318 s (avg 224 s), 30 steps
MiniMax Music 3.licence: MiniMax-Music3 Community License: commercial use OK, must show 'MiniMax-Music3' in the product UI, written authorisation above USD 20M yearly revenue

ACE-Step 1.5.version: ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5 ca1e85f; turbo 2B + LM 1.7B and XL-SFT 4B were smoke-tested
ACE-Step 1.5.status: dropped by the user (too heavy for this machine) - not in the bake-off
ACE-Step 1.5.speed: 60 s take: 31 s (turbo 2B + LM 1.7B), 84 s (XL-SFT, 50 steps, while another model ran)
ACE-Step 1.5.memory: 15 GB RSS (turbo), 22 GB RSS (XL-SFT); MLX peak 28 GB

notes: Speeds/memory measured on the M5 Max (128 GB), one model at a time, 2026-09-22.
Only MiniMax Music 3 and HeartMuLa write a full 60-90 s theme. Stable Audio Open 1.0 stops at 47 s (stitching or outpainting needed for a theme); SAO Small is loop/sting material.

Key/BPM control: none of the four holds the brief's D major / BPM reliably. SAO 1.0 hits the BPM most often (it reads 'N BPM' from the prompt); MiniMax mostly lands in G or C major regardless of the prompt; HeartMuLa has no tempo/key input at all.

Voices: HeartMuLa is a song model and hums/sings under many takes (demucs finds a voice-like stem in most); some MiniMax takes also sing despite '[Instrumental]' lyrics. Takes with >20% vocal-stem energy are kept off the shortlist.
ACE-Step 1.5 was set up and smoke-tested (MLX, MIT) but dropped by the user as too heavy for this machine, so it has no takes here.

Licences differ: HeartMuLa is Apache-2.0; Stable Audio Open needs Stability registration for commercial use and a 'Powered by Stability AI' credit (free under USD 1M revenue); MiniMax Music 3 needs 'MiniMax-Music3' shown in the game's UI (free under USD 20M revenue).
